svg.title: MathKX data model
svg.text: MathKX data model: content contract (0.1-pilot) and runtime entities
Content entities are versioned files under content/ (spec 001 data-model.md). Runtime entities are the decided concepts whose storage shape in PostgreSQL is not yet designed.
Content in Git, validated by tools/validate-content.mjs in CI
Language-neutral IDs; nb and en ship together; identity = id + version
content/registry/*.json: reviewed lists of what tested code provides
Names, versions, bounds and shapes only; no logic (constitution III). Domain tests assert code matches.
Runtime (PostgreSQL, ADR 0008): decided concepts, storage shape not yet designed
Anonymous profiles (ADR 0006); honest progress without mastery percentages; reproducible instances (ADR 0004)
prose and order are free per language
texts per language come with F3
attributes: { a, b, start: int min..max }
